dialogues.speaker: House Specialties
dialogues.text: "We'd like to specially recommend our Tatacos! Ask anyone in Natlan — these tasty treats are not to be missed!"

dialogues.speaker: House Specialties
dialogues.text: "This quick, convenient food is made with Grainfruit, Shrimp, Cheese, and Onions, and is the perfect calorie-packed pick-me-up to fuel you up!"

dialogues.speaker: House Specialties
dialogues.text: "Visitors from abroad should also try our Saurus Crackers — a snack beloved by both humans and Saurians! Milk and Xocoatl are the ultimate combination! Dunk 'em and dip 'em before eating!"
